title: Millions join Spain's first general strike in 14 years as anger over housing leads to clashes
summary: A general strike by 4 million Spanish workers — around one-fifth of the total workforce — against the country's housing crisis was mostly peaceful on Wednesday, unions said, though by the evening clashes erupted in some areas of Barcelona and Madrid.
